description: Four dancers join one hand in the middle and walk the ring round.

walkthrough.line: Put your {hand} hand on the wrist of the dancer ahead and walk forward, {places}.
walkthrough.teach: All four put the {hand} hand on the wrist of the dancer ahead of you round the star, keeping your arm a little bent so the hands make a ring rather than a pile. Walk forward round the center, {places}.

walkthrough.line: Take {hand} hands with the dancer diagonally across, one hand each, and walk forward, {places}.
walkthrough.teach: Reach across the star and take {hand} hands with the dancer diagonally across from you, one hand each, the robins' pair held a little above the larks'. Walk forward round the center, {places}.
